topic: My toddler won't stay in the new big-kid bed
video_title: My toddler won't stay in bed: big-kid bed tips (2-3 years)
caption:
My toddler won't stay in the new big-kid bed.

Ages 2-4: twenty bedtime comebacks in one evening is not unusual.
Keep every visit calm, brief and boring.
One rule: once it's sleep time, everyone stays in bed until morning.
Praise them in the morning for staying in bed all night.
